note: gc-markhelpers-verify-1118 (PREPARED, NOT LAUNCHED; correctness, never timing): docs/287 §8 [GC] MarkHelpersVerify, the exactness check for [GC] MarkHelpers=2 (IdleGate=1, SubTimers=1). Experimental, not released. Needs feature/gc-markhelpers-p4-1118 merged into the checkout queue.ts runs from (agent.js g5VerifySub / g5VerifySkip names). Bin state apex (or apex-rewind) via tools/turbo-compat.ts in the chain. Run after gc-markhelpers-correct-1118 passes and before gc-markhelpers-time-1118. Smoke first (BP 5 min, MarkHelpersVerify=1 = every finished incremental mark, stops the queue on fail), then BP / SV / IP 10 min with MarkHelpersVerify=4. Each check stops the world and marks the heap twice more: a visible hitch per check is expected, frame times of this queue mean nothing. Pass per job: no crash, script errors 0, version + idle-gate + install lines, at least one "OK   GC mark verify" line, no FAIL / WARN / skip line, g5VerifyN > 0, g5VerifyBad 0 (helper mark != serial mark from the same snapshot: g5Mode latches 0), g5VerifySub 0 (serial mark found an object the cycle left unmarked), g5VerifySkip 0, plus the P3 gates. Triage of g5VerifySub > 0 with g5VerifyBad 0: the "outside:" lines in ts3native.log name block, kind and size; rerun the job with g5Mode 0 from the start for the noise floor of the conservative root scan before calling it a helper bug (docs/287 §8.4). Household: the GC decides nothing about Sims; the check proves the marked set equals the serial marker's, so household / selected / unknown-scope exemptions do not apply; script errors 0 and the standard save-hash guard cover it.
